name: Alibaba Health Information Technology Limited
summary: Alibaba Health Information Technology Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the pharmaceutical direct sales, pharmaceutical e-commerce platform, and healthcare and digital services businesses in the People's Republic of China. It offers a range of prescription and over-the-counter drugs, nutritional supplements, medical devices, contact lenses, healthcare food, adult and family planning products, and various other health-related products. The company also provides medical and healthcare services, including medical checkups, testing, medical consultation, appointment-booking, physical examination, consultation, registration, vaccine, dentistry, psychology, optometry, and nursing …
